business_summary: Brite Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., an integrated circuit design service company, provides customized ASIC and IP solutions in China and internationally. The company offers chip design and mass production services, as well as chip customization services, including chip definition and delivery, IP selection and authorization, specification and architecture design, logic and physical design, design data verification, tape-out solution design, and other full-process chip design services. It also provides semiconductor IP products (You IP), such as YouDDR, a DDR interface solution; YouSerdes, a multi-rate serdes IP solution; YouMIPI, a CSI2 interface solution; YouUSB, a USB PHY solution; YouPCIe, a system solution; YouONFI, a NAND PHY solution; YouIO, an I/O solution; YouRF, including YouRF-Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), YouRF-Narrow-band (NB) IoT, YouRF proprietary 2.4G, and YouRF transceiver 802.15.4G products; and YouADC products. In addition, the company offers YouSiP solutions consisting of YouSiP-IOM, an internet of meters platform; YouSiP-Audio, an audio DSP platform; YouSiP-Vision, a vision DSP platform; YouSiP, an IoT platform; and YouSiP-AP, an AP platform. Its products are used in the Internet of Things, networking, industrial control, consumer electronics, network communication, smart cities, and high-performance computing industries. The company serves system manufacturers and chip design companies. Further, it engages in investment activities. Brite Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
